summary: Planet Coaster entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Planet Coaster
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows PC release with DLC and Workshop state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with exact DLC/Workshop/park state documented

primary.version: Current PC release with DLC/Workshop state documented
primary.why: The PC release is the fidelity route for large parks, custom scenery, Steam Workshop sharing, and capture flexibility. Console Edition and Planet Coaster 2 are useful comparisons but should not replace the original PC route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release. Record storefront/build, DLC ownership, Workshop assets, scenario/sandbox/challenge mode, park size, graphics settings, mods/blueprints, and whether Console Edition or Planet Coaster 2 were compared.

secondary.why: PC is the best route for Workshop/customization and capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: Planet Coaster 2 is a sequel, not a replacement for this entry.
